# function

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.function` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | Definition |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `[local] function <name>(<arguments>):` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
